why: Both chats answered by comparing inverter models: APsystems EZ1-LV, Hoymiles HiFlow Pro LV, EcoFlow STREAM and Enphase IQ8M. Neither chat told the shopper to buy a second item to make the inverter work, and the panels were only mentioned as input specs ("supports two solar panels"). The deciding facts are 120 V US output and UL 3700 certification for outlet use versus UL 1741-only rooftop units. Those facts decide which inverter to pick, not which set to buy, so a single-product comparison that recommends one model fits the question.
